Hi Tamara / John —

Thanks again for the discovery conversation earlier today — really appreciate the context on your performance goals and the procurement timeline. Per our call, I’ve put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (attached) with milestones, owners, and two timeline options so we can align on a target close date. Quick summary below and an ask to confirm stakeholders so I can finalize the MAP.

High level (see attached BRH_MAP_v1.xlsx):
- Target: two timeline options
  - Option A (accelerated): Executive approval + procurement signoff by 2026-08-10 (recommended if procurement can prioritize)
  - Option B (standard): Contract and legal review complete by 2026-08-20
- Key milestones (owners):
  1) MAP review & confirm stakeholders — Owner: BrightRiver (Tamara / John) — Week of 7/13
  2) Technical POC (integration + perf baseline) — Owner: BrightRiver Eng / Redwood SE (Aditya) — target 7/20–7/30
  3) Security & compliance Q&A / evidence exchange — Owner: BrightRiver Security / Redwood (Marissa + Aditya) — target 7/21–8/5
  4) Commercial terms & SOW signoff — Owner: BrightRiver Procurement / Redwood Legal (Monica) — target per timeline option
  5) Production onboarding & runbook handoff — Owner: BrightRiver Ops / Redwood CS — target 8/10–8/25
- Dependencies: procurement lead availability, SOC2 evidence request turnaround (~3–5 business days), API access for POC environment

Ask: can you confirm the stakeholder list (I have Tamara, John, and procurement contact Steve Morgan — please confirm emails and any additional approvers), and which timeline option you'd like to pursue? If Option A, we’ll prioritize a brief procurement touchpoint this week.

I’ve attached:
- BRH_MAP_v1.xlsx (initial MAP with milestones / RACI / dates)
- SOW-draft.pdf (commercial starting point)

Proposed next step: 30–45 minute MAP review call to walk through the attached and lock owners/times. I’m available 7/13 10–12 PT or 7/14 9–11 PT — can you share a time that works?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
